description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction class, testing JSON extraction methods, message formatting, and JavaScript dispatch string generation.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIActionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing methods of OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction.

methods.name: extractActionNameAcceptsNameOrAction
methods.description: Tests that the extractActionName method correctly extracts 'name' or 'action' from JSON objects.

methods.name: formatAgentMessageMatchesSharedSpec
methods.description: Verifies that the formatAgentMessage method produces the expected formatted string.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2uiStatusIsStable
methods.description: Checks that the JavaScript string for a successful status is correctly generated.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2uiStatusQuotesControlCharacters
methods.description: Ensures that control and special characters in status strings are properly escaped in JavaScript output.
